title: I've been building a few free apps and an open-source game in my spare time
author: Select-Investment-75
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I've been spending quite a bit of my free time learning, experimenting and building things, and I figured I'd share some of what I've been working on.

I recently put together a website called **Taren**, where I'm collecting my projects.

A few things I've built so far:

* **MineClone** – An open-source Minecraft-inspired game. Just a fun project to see how far I could take it.
* **PDF Studio** – A Windows application for working with PDF files. The idea was to create something useful without having to pay for a subscription.
* **Lumen Capture** – A Windows screen recording app I've been working on, with a focus on keeping things simple and practical.

Everything is **free to download and use**. MineClone is also open source.

I'm not a professional software company or anything like that. I just enjoy building stuff, learning along the way and seeing what I can come up with.

If you find something useful and feel like supporting my projects, there's a Ko-fi link on the website where you can buy me a coffee. Completely optional, of course. No pressure at all.

You can check everything out here:

[**https://taren.se**](https://taren.se)

I'd genuinely appreciate any feedback, bug reports or suggestions. There's always something that can be improved!

Thanks for checking it out!
